intro: Step into Antalya Old Town, a historic town in Antalya province whose story begins in the 2nd century AD. This walled old town wraps around the Roman harbour, and along the same narrow lanes Hadrian's Gate, the Fluted Minaret and Ottoman mansions stand side by side.
history: Kaleiçi is the present name of the walled city that grew around the harbour of Roman Attaleia. The three-arched gate raised for the emperor Hadrian's visit in AD 130 is still one of its main entrances. Through the Seljuk and Ottoman centuries the city stayed within these walls, and the bow-fronted timber mansions lining its lanes date from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss Hadrian's Gate, the Fluted Minaret and the Broken Minaret, and let your walk lead you to the Roman harbour and walls.
facts: Did you know? The building beneath the Broken Minaret was in turn a Roman temple, a Byzantine church, a mosque, a church again and a mosque once more: the city's whole history is legible on one set of foundations. And Hadrian's Gate, built for the emperor's visit in AD 130, is still one of the main ways into the old town.
outro: This brings our tour of Antalya Old Town to an end. Before you go, please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Enjoy the lanes, and enjoy your visit.
